title: 第二十七章 阿青认纹
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
乱葬沟终于安静下来。

    不是彻底干净。

    这里死了太多人，脏了太久，不是一夜能洗清的。只是那些哭声不再乱撞，像终于找到一点能靠的地方。

    燕不归让役吏封存七块烧名骨牌。

    “轻点。”沈清萝提醒。

    役吏看她。

    “骨牌底下还有魂灰，碰碎了不好补。”

    燕不归道：“听她的。”

    那役吏立刻轻了许多。

    阿满的魂影虚弱得快散，只能暂时收进引魂铃。阿泥挤在他旁边，小声叫哥哥。阿满嫌他吵，却没有推开。

    糖糕趴在临时木牌上，累得尾巴都不想甩。

    “本仙今日至少值三条小鱼干。”

    铁柱认真记下：“三条，待议。”

    糖糕瞬间抬头：“又待议？”

    沈清萝蹲在一旁，把完整清虚符纹拓到黄纸上。

    拓的时候她特意慢，一笔一笔对着原纹描，半点不敢错。这纹是眼下唯一能带回玄司的东西，描歪一笔，回头就少一条能查的线。

    阿青飘在她身后，看着那只闭眼纹，迟迟没说话。

    沈清萝没催。

    过了很久，阿青忽然捂住头。

    她纸身一阵发白，像被火从里面燎过。

    “阿青！”

    沈清萝伸手去扶，却只碰到一片冷纸。

    阿青的声音断断续续。

    “白台……很多白袖子……”

    谢无咎猛地看过去。

    阿青像没看见他，只盯着那枚符纹。

    “有人说……渊眷有罪。”

    谢无咎脸色骤然冷下。

    燕不归也皱眉：“渊眷？”

    沈清萝看向谢无咎。

    “什么意思？”

    谢无咎没有答。

    阿青还在抖。

    “有个姑娘……被推到符火前。她手上好像也有红黑线。不是很清楚，我看不清她的脸。”

    沈清萝按住引魂铃，让阿青魂丝稳一点。

    “别想了。”

    阿青低声：“可我觉得疼。阿萝，我一听那两个字就疼。”

    谢无咎忽然道：“别想。”

    沈清萝抬头。

    “你又知道？”

    谢无咎冷声：“知道也没用。”

    这句话一出来，沈清萝的火就上来了。

    她刚刚耗了半条命救小鬼，这人还在这里惜字如金。

    “有没有用，不该由你替我判。”

    谢无咎沉默。

    气氛一时硬住。
content_en:
The mass grave finally became quiet.

Not completely clean.

Too many people have died here and it has been dirty for too long. It cannot be cleaned overnight.It’s just that those cries are no longer chaotic, as if they have finally found a place to lean on.

Yan Bugui asked the servants to seal up the seven famous dominoes.

"Be gentle." Shen Qingluo reminded.

The servant looked at her.

"There's still soul ashes underneath the dominoes. It's hard to repair them if they're broken."

Yan Bugui said: "Listen to her."

The servant immediately became much lighter.

Aman's soul shadow was so weak that it was about to dissipate, so he could only put it into the soul-inducing bell temporarily.Ah Ni squeezed next to him and called her brother in a low voice.Aman thought he was noisy, but didn't push him away.

Tang Cake was lying on the temporary wooden sign, so tired that he didn't even want to flick his tail.

"I am worth at least three small dried fishes today."

Tie Zhu carefully wrote down: "Three items to be discussed."

Tang Cake instantly raised his head: "Are we waiting for discussion?"

Shen Qingluo squatted aside and spread the complete Qingxu rune pattern onto the yellow paper.

She was deliberately slow when drawing, tracing the original pattern one stroke at a time, not daring to make any mistakes.This pattern is the only thing that can be brought back to Xuansi at the moment. If you trace it wrongly, there will be one less line that can be checked later.

Ah Qing floated behind her, looking at the closed eye pattern, but didn't speak for a long time.

Shen Qingluo didn't rush.

After a long time, Ah Qing suddenly covered his head.

Her paper body turned white for a while, as if it had been burned by fire from the inside.

"Aqing!"

Shen Qingluo reached out to help, but only encountered a piece of cold paper.

Ah Qing's voice was broken.

"White platform...many white sleeves..."

Xie Wujiu looked over sharply.

Ah Qing didn't seem to see him, only staring at the talisman.

"Some people say... Yuanjuan is guilty."

Xie Wujiu's face suddenly turned cold.

Yan Bugui also frowned: "Yuanjuan?"

Shen Qingluo looked at Xie Wujiu.

"What do you mean?"

Xie Wujiu didn't answer.

Ah Qing was still shaking.

"There was a girl... who was pushed in front of the talisman. She also seemed to have red and black lines on her hands. It wasn't very clear. I couldn't see her face clearly."

Shen Qingluo pressed the soul-inducing bell to make Ah Qinghun's silk thread more stable.

"Don't think about it."

Ah Qing whispered: "But I feel pain. Ah Luo, I feel pain when I hear those two words."

Xie Wujiu suddenly said: "Don't think about it."

Shen Qingluo looked up.

"You know what?"

Xie Wujiu said coldly: "It's useless to know."

As soon as these words came out, Shen Qingluo became angry.

She had just spent half her life saving a kid, and this guy was still here cherishing his words like gold.

"Whether it's useful or not, it's not up to you to judge for me."

Xie Wujiu remained silent.

The atmosphere was tense for a moment.
